tool_schemas.name: getTokenPrice
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest stored price snapshot for the requested token symbol and includes the token identifier you requested along with its current price data. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `token` is missing/empty or not a supported symbol format, and NOT_FOUND if the token is not present in the catalog or has no price snapshot available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if access is not permitted and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getAnnoucements
tool_schemas.description: Searches exchange-style announcements published within the last month, filtered by `anType`, and returns the matching announcement entries (no pagination is supported for this query). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `anType` is missing or not one of the allowed values, and NOT_FOUND if there are no announcements in the last month for the requested type. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if access is not permitted and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getCoinInfo
tool_schemas.description:
Get spot coin information。Parameter：coin - Coin name
Response Parameters 
- coin: Token name  
- transfer: Transferability  
- chains: Support chain list  
  - chain: Chain name  
  - needTag: Need tag  
  - withdrawable: Withdrawal supported  
  - rechargeable: Deposit supported  
  - withdrawFee: Withdrawal transaction fee  
  - extraWithdrawFee: Extra charge (e.g., 0.1 means 10% on-chain destruction)  
  - browserUrl: Blockchain explorer address  
  - contractAddress: Coin contract address  
  - withdrawStep: Withdrawal count step (if not 0, withdrawal size must be a multiple of this value; if 0, no such limit)  
  - withdrawMinScale: Decimal places of withdrawal amount  
  - congestion: Chain network status (normal: normal, congested: congestion)

tool_schemas.name: listTokens
tool_schemas.description: Lists tokens in the catalog with optional filtering by symbol/name, status, and spot support. Returns a paginated result ordered by symbol, and refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR; requires authorization and may return RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

query.description: Optional free-text filter matched against token symbol, name, or aliases (case-insensitive).

is_spot_supported.description: Filter tokens by spot support flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getToken
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single token by its id. Returns the token record if found; raises NOT_FOUND if the token id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if access is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: upsertToken
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new token or updates an existing token by `id`. Validates lifecycle transitions for `status` and refuses invalid transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR; refuses attempts to modify immutable identifiers with VALIDATION_ERROR. Returns the stored token record on success; requires authorization and may return RATE_LIMITED.

id.description: Token primary key. If provided and exists, the token is updated; if not found, a new token is created.

is_spot_supported.description: Whether spot trading is supported for this token.

transfer.description: Transferability metadata blob as provided by upstream exchange sources.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active↔inactive, active/inactive→delisted; delisted is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: listAnnouncements
tool_schemas.description: Lists announcements with pagination and optional filtering by type and status. Returns results ordered by published_at descending. Refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR; requires authorization and may return RATE_LIMITED.

published_from.description: Only return announcements with published_at >= this timestamp.

published_to.description: Only return announcements with published_at <= this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of announcements to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: upsertAnnouncement
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new announcement or updates an existing one by `id`. Enforces announcement lifecycle transitions (published→archived/retracted, archived→retracted) and refuses invalid transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR. Rejects announcements with published_at unreasonably far in the future (more than 24 hours) with VALIDATION_ERROR. Returns the stored announcement record; requires authorization and may return RATE_LIMITED.

id.description: Announcement primary key. If provided and exists, the announcement is updated; if not found, a new announcement is created.

url.description: Canonical source URL for the announcement.

published_at.description: Publish timestamp (must not be >24h in the future).
